notes:
Desktop v5.0.53

  • Added "Browse" button to Import World from ZIP dialog — native file picker with .zip filter for easier world imports
  • Extended file picker filters across all dialogs: server icons (png, jpg, jpeg), server JARs (jar), world imports (zip), plugins/mods (jar, multi-select), datapacks (zip, multi-select), server file uploads (jar, zip, json, yml, yaml, properties, txt, conf, config, toml, dat, db, log, multi-select)
  • Updated UpdateChecker to use portalhost.pages.dev/latest.json as primary update source (public, no auth, no rate limits) with GitHub API and HTML scraping as fallbacks
  • Rebuilt MSI (~121 MB) and EXE (~122 MB) installers with updated update checker

Desktop v5.0.52

  • Fixed close dialog "Quit" button — now properly stops all running servers and exits the application cleanly (previously just hid the window without cleanup)
  • Removed GitHub token initialization from main() — token now passed explicitly to UpdateChecker.checkForUpdate() only when user provides it in Settings
  • Updated version to 5.0.52 across all build files (build.gradle.kts, BuildConfig.kt, WiX template, jpackage.cfg)
  • Removed unused Base64 import from UpdateChecker
  • Fixed window visibility state handling on close dialog

Desktop v5.0.51

  • Fixed window dragging jitter in TitleBar — replaced custom drag logic with pixel-perfect detectDragGestures implementation
  • Fixed FilePicker deadlock — completely rewrote FilePicker.kt as proper suspend function using withContext(Dispatchers.IO), removing blocking SwingUtilities.invokeLater + synchronized wait pattern
  • Server folders now use sanitized server name instead of UUID (with UUID fallback for backward compatibility) — folders are human-readable and portable
  • Enabled native Windows file dialog via awt.fileDialog.useNativeLF=true — users now get standard Windows Explorer dialogs
  • All 6 FilePicker call sites updated to use coroutine scope launch

Desktop v5.0.50 — Major UI Overhaul

  • Complete Material3 design system migration with dark theme matching Minecraft aesthetic
  • New 6-step server creation wizard: Version → Type → Build → Java → Memory → Finish
  • Real-time console with color-coded log levels, command history (up/down arrows), search/filter, and auto-scroll toggle
  • Player management: ban/unban players & IPs, kick, whitelist add/remove, op/de-op, online player list with UUIDs
  • World management: import/export as ZIP, create/delete/switch worlds, world folder size display
  • Plugin/mod/datapack management: drag-and-drop JAR/ZIP upload, multi-select, delete, version display
  • System tray integration: minimize to tray, quick start/stop/restart, show/hide window, server status tooltip
  • Automatic JDK detection and installation — downloads Adoptium Temurin JDK 8/11/17/21 based on server version requirements
  • Multi-version support: Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia, Vanilla with build selection per version
  • Server properties editor with live preview for MOTD color codes (§0-§f, §l, §o, §n, §m, §k, §r)
  • RCON configuration panel with enable/disable, port, password fields
  • Auto-restart and auto-backup toggles with configurable intervals

Android v5.0.30 — Initial Android Release

  • Full Minecraft Java Edition server manager for Android 7.0+ (API 24)
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with persistent notification showing CPU/RAM/TPS
  • Complete server lifecycle: create, configure, start, stop, restart, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with same server type support as desktop (Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia, Vanilla)
  • Player management: view online players with ping, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs with add/remove
  • Real-time console with ANSI color support, log level filtering, search, command history, copy/share
  • Performance charts: live CPU%, RAM usage, TPS history graphs with configurable time ranges
  • playit.gg tunnel integration — create public TCP tunnels for server access without port forwarding
  • RCON remote console support with authentication, command sending, response display
  • File management: worlds, plugins, mods, datapacks, backups — upload, download, delete, rename
  • Automatic JDK installation (Adoptium Temurin) with device-appropriate version selection
  • Device-aware RAM/GC configuration — automatically tunes -Xms/-Xmx and GC flags based on available memory
  • Battery optimization exemption request to keep servers running in background
  • Dark/Light theme support with system sync and manual override
  • APK size: ~15 MB (native/PortalHost.apk), package: com.portalhost.app, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36

Desktop v5.0.25

  • Custom WiX installer template (template.wxs) with branded UI, license agreement, and custom actions
  • Creates "Uninstall PortalHost.lnk" shortcut in Start Menu and self-locating Uninstall.bat in install folder
  • Uninstall.bat uses %~dp0 for self-location — works regardless of working directory
  • Update checker with GitHub API (authenticated) and HTML fallback scraping for private repo access
  • Release tag regex handles suffixes like -desktop, -android for multi-platform releases
  • GitHub token support stored in DataStore preferences — user enters PAT in Settings → Updates
  • Version parsing compares major.minor.patch numerically, ignores pre-release suffixes
  • Toast notifications for update available, download progress, install ready

Desktop v5.0.20 — Compose Multiplatform Migration

  • Full migration from Swing/JavaFX to Compose Multiplatform (Kotlin 1.9+, Compose 1.5+)
  • Kotlin Multiplatform project structure: commonMain (shared logic), desktopMain (JVM UI)
  • ServerManager with sanitized folder names (replaces invalid chars: \ / : * ? " < > | with _)
  • Preferences via Multiplatform Settings (DataStore on JVM) — JDK paths, GitHub token, theme, auto-update
  • Dashboard with server cards showing status badge, version, type, memory, port, quick actions
  • ProcessManager with ManagedProcess wrapper — stdout/stderr capture, PID tracking, graceful shutdown
  • ServerDownloader with PaperMC, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia API integrations
  • JdkManager auto-detects installed JDKs, downloads missing versions from Adoptium API
  • SQLite database via SQLDelight for server configs, console logs, backup metadata, player data
  • Koin dependency injection for all services (ServerManager, ProcessManager, JdkManager, etc.)
